name: Declares Statement
description: An authorization policy (an SCP or an RCP) declares one statement of its policy document (policy -> statement), as organizations:DescribePolicy returns the document. Containment: the policy declares it in CONTAINMENT_EDGES, so a statement removed from the document becomes a retirement candidate, and retiring the policy retires its statements. The listing behind it is the policy's own document: complete when DescribePolicy succeeded and the document parsed.
